note: Both Kindle builds were compiled with Amazon's kindlegen (bundled in Kindle Previewer) and read back to confirm all 154,439 headwords. This revision builds on H. Yazdani's English-Persian dictionary v2.4 as published by hossein1376 (MIT licence); the original word list descends from the MHM Advance English-Persian Dictionary.
limits: Not verified on every device. The Kindle .mobi files were compiled and read back by software, the StarDict and Kobo files were built and look-ups were resolved programmatically; none was checked screen by screen on each e-reader generation.

About 107,000 specialised entries received mechanical repairs only (word order, letters, half-spaces, numbers). Their wording is still the 1990s original, including words run together such as دورازمحور, which cannot be split safely by rule.

The 7,000 rewritten entries and the new entries were written by AI models acting as lexicographers and have not been reviewed by a human Persian editor. A few newly coined terms with no settled Persian equivalent are descriptive glosses.
Headword typo correction covered words within one edit of a known English word. Misspellings further from the intended word, and wrong words that happen to be valid English, remain.
PocketBook's built-in dictionary uses its own .dic format, which is not produced here; use KOReader with the StarDict build on PocketBook.
